title: What If the Earth Stopped Spinning?
lines: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
At the equator, | you're moving at {about/~about} {1,670 kilometers an hour~one thousand six hundred seventy kilometers an hour}.
Stop the planet suddenly, | and {anything/~anything} not bolted {down/~down} flies east.
So does the air, at more {than/~than} {1,000 kilometers an hour~a thousand kilometers an hour}.
Without spin, | the water bulging at the {equator/~equator} slides to the poles.
{2~Two} polar oceans, one giant {continent/~continent} around the middle.
One day would last a whole year: | {6 months~six months} of daylight, {6 months~six months} of night.
{400 million years~four hundred million years} {ago,/~ago,} a year had about {400 days~four hundred days}.
At today's rate, how long until a day lasts {25 hours~twenty-five hours}? | About {20,000~twenty thousand} years, | or about {200 million~two hundred million} years? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: If Earth stopped spinning, | winds would blow at over {1,000 kilometers an hour~a thousand kilometers an hour}.
